notes: *more and more* is divided across הָלוֹךְ, the waw and קָשָׁה, each morpheme taking a word the ASV wrote: a source item stands on either side of the English *and*, which is the test rule 14 sets for a coordinator inside one morpheme's rendering. The competing reading fuses the two lexical morphemes into one unit carrying the whole phrase (rules 2, 8, 56).
עַד אֲשֶׁר fuses to *until*, headed on the governing first morpheme exactly as כַּאֲשֶׁר → *as* is (rules 23, 30); the competing reading marks אֲשֶׁר unrepresented.
